## 🌸 Baizhi Notes & TODO Secretary
Automated Discord secretary for **Kacper**.

• Listens to `!N`, `!notes`, `!todo` in Discord
• Eliminates duplicates & cleans text
• Baizhi AI synthesizes daily digest
• Posts to `#notes-notes-notes` on Discord
• Saves Markdown note to Obsidian Vault
